## Description and Rationale

I am a data enthusiast with a strong interest in data science, machine learning, and real-world applications of data. I enjoy working with challenging datasets and trying to find patterns that can be turned into useful predictions.

I decided to participate in the 2026 Data Challenge because the problem is both technically interesting and highly relevant to the aviation sector. Predicting taxi-out time is not straightforward, as it can depend on many different factors, and I would like to explore how well data-driven approaches can capture these complexities.

For me, this challenge is a great opportunity to test my skills on a real-world problem, learn from aviation data, and experiment with different modelling approaches. I am also motivated by the possibility of contributing, even in a small way, to improving the efficiency and sustainability of air transport.
